rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty and quality of the TE/ICM from a single image and labels it 'top tier' despite 3AA not being the highest expansion stage.
Thoroughly integrates age, DOR/AMH, oocyte yield, BMI, sperm quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate, though some claims (e.g., DOR implying higher aneuploidy at this age, sedentary lifestyle effect) are somewhat overstated.

Core recommendations such as proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but suggestions like routine low-dose aspirin, strong PGT-A endorsement in low-yield DOR, and ERA/Receptiva after one failure are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some proposed interventions are more speculative than standard practice.
